app.name: Kurram Pul
app.tagline: Who needs what, how urgently, and who can help nearby
app.pitch: When the road to Parachinar closes, Kurram Pul tells responders who needs what, how urgently, who can help nearby, and how soon it might happen again.
app.demoBadgeText: Simulated reports and history. Not real-world findings.

ai.caution: AI-generated from simulated reports. Check before acting on it.

about.title: About this crisis
about.modeledOn: The closure this is modeled on
about.closureLabel: Parachinar’s only road was shut to all traffic from {start} until the first relief convoy was sent on {end}.
about.childrenLabel: children died in Parachinar from shortages of medicine caused by the closure.
about.commsFact: Mobile data (3G/4G) in Kurram has been suspended for nearly two years.
about.jirgaFact: A grand jirga in Kohat brokered the 14-point peace accord both sides signed on {date}.

explore.dashboard: See which areas are short of what, who verified each report, and which areas have gone silent.

about.mapCaption: Parachinar sits at the end of one road. When the Thall road and the Kharlachi crossing close, every area here is cut off at once.

report.title: Report
report.body: A health worker or resident describes a patient, by chat or by SMS.

see.title: See
see.body: Every report lands on one shared dashboard, vouched for by named elders and facility records.

match.title: Match
match.body: Spare stock in one area is matched to shortages next door, the same day.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.body: Past closures and current signals warn hospitals when to stock up.

who.title: Who uses it first
who.intro: People who already coordinate in every closure. No new institution needed.

hospital.title: DHQ Hospital staff
hospital.body: Log medicine and equipment stock, and see where spare supplies are nearby.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacies
pharmacy.body: Report what has run out, and what they can spare.

edhi.title: Edhi Foundation coordinators
edhi.body: Report from the community, and carry same-day transfers between areas.

elders.title: Jirga elders
elders.body: Vouch for reports from their area, so responders know which to trust.

tour.label: Guided tour

triage.title: A health worker reports a sick baby
triage.body: Triage reads the description and answers in seconds: critical, get to hospital now. The case is logged to Parachinar automatically, and the same works over SMS when mobile data is down.

dashboard.title: It shows up where responders look
dashboard.body: Parachinar's card now lists the new critical case beside the hospital's own stock reports, each marked with who verified it.

matcher.title: Spare stock next door, not across a closed road
matcher.body: Pewar, next door in Upper Kurram, has verified spare insulin for Parachinar's critical shortage. One tap tells the coordinator to move it today.

forecast.title: Prepare before the road closes again
forecast.body: Six past closures and this week's signals give a risk level, and what hospitals should stock up on now.

done.title: That's the whole loop
done.body: Report, see, match, prepare. Switch to اردو or پښتو at the foot of the menu, or type your own case in Triage.

tour.promptTitle: New here? See it all in 60 seconds
tour.promptBody: The tour follows one real case: a sick baby in Parachinar, from triage to the dashboard, to spare stock next door, to the next closure.
